newsitem.title: USA: Ontrack signs service pact with Comservco.
newsitem.headline: Ontrack signs service pact with Comservco.

text.p: Ontrack Data International Inc said Friday it signed a service partner agreement with Comservco USA Inc to help Ontrack meet the data recovery requirements of its customers.
This partnership provides Ontrack with the opportunity to further its service offering to Fortune 1000 companies, which make up more than 80 percent of Comservco's customer base, it added.
Comservco provides service and support for micro-based products, microcomputers, printers, and other micro-based peripherals.

Ontrack Data is a vendor of services and software designed to maximize the integrity and security of hard disk drive data. Its Ontrack Data Recovery Inc unit specializes in recovering lost or corrupted data from any hard drive or alternative storage device.
